_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the Left 4 Dead 2 egg in https://github.com/pterodactyl/game-eggs (MIT).
name: Left 4 Dead 2
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Valve's co-op zombie shooter for four survivors, with versus and scavenge. Installs the dedicated server with SteamCMD and keeps it updated.
startup: if [ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" = 1 ]; then up() { ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /home/container +login anonymous +@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType "$1" +app_update {{SRCDS_APPID}} ${SRCDS_BETAID:+-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID"} ${SRCDS_BETAPASS:+-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS"} $2 +quit 2>&1 | tee Steam/update.log; grep -aq "Success! App" Steam/update.log; }; mkdir -p Steam; up linux $([ "{{VALIDATE}}" = 1 ] && echo validate) || { grep -aq "Invalid platform" Steam/update.log && up windows && up linux validate; } || echo "Steam couldn't update the game, so the server starts as it is."; fi; exec ./srcds_run -game left4dead2 -console -norestart -strictportbind -ip 0.0.0.0 -port {{SERVER_PORT}} +map {{SRCDS_MAP}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Left 4 Dead 2. Installs or updates the dedicated server (Steam app 222860)
# with SteamCMD, signed in anonymously. Settings in server.cfg, addons and
# maps are kept.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server
app="${SRCDS_APPID:-222860}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# SteamCMD stays in the server folder, so the server can update itself at start.
if [ ! -x steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    echo "Downloading SteamCMD"
    mkdir -p steamcmd
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi
mkdir -p steamapps
beta=()
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || beta+=(-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ] || beta+=(-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS")
validate=()
[ "${VALIDATE:-0}" != 1 ] || validate=(validate)
steam() { # platform, extra app_update arguments
    local platform=$1
    shift
    ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous \
        +@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType "$platform" +app_update "$app" "${beta[@]}" "$@" +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
    grep -aq "Success! App '$app'" /tmp/steamcmd.log
}
# SteamCMD often fails once for no lasting reason (Missing configuration,
# state 0x202 or 0x602 after it updates itself): try again, up to 5 times.
for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    steam linux "${validate[@]}" && break
    err=$(grep -aoE '(ERROR|Error)! .*' /tmp/steamcmd.log | tail -n 1) || true
    case "$err" in
    *"No subscription"*) fail "Steam won't give this game to an anonymous account, so it can't be installed." ;;
    *"Invalid Password"* | *"Invalid beta"*) fail "Steam refused the beta branch or its password. Check Beta branch and Beta password, then reinstall." ;;
    *"Invalid platform"*)
        # Steam refuses the Linux server to anonymous accounts until the
        # app is known on the disk: fetch it as Windows, then validate as
        # Linux, which swaps in the Linux files.
        echo "Steam refused the Linux files at first; fetching the game as Windows, then switching it to Linux."
        steam windows && steam linux validate && break
        err=$(grep -aoE '(ERROR|Error)! .*' /tmp/steamcmd.log | tail -n 1) || true
        ;;
    esac
    [ "$try" = 5 ] && fail "SteamCMD failed 5 times (${err:-no error given}). If it mentions 0x202, the server may be out of disk space. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "SteamCMD failed; trying again ($((try + 1)) of 5)."
    sleep 5
done
[ -x srcds_run ] || fail "Steam finished, but the Linux server (srcds_run) is missing. Reinstall to try again."
# Steam's client library, where the game looks for it.
mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64
cp -f steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/
build=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*"buildid"[[:space:]]*"\([0-9]*\)".*/\1/p' "steamapps/appmanifest_$app.acf" | head -n 1)

# The settings the Panel writes into server.cfg at every start need a line
# each to replace; the rest of the file is the owner's.
cfg=left4dead2/cfg/server.cfg
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$cfg")"
touch "$cfg"
for key in hostname sv_password rcon_password; do
    grep -q "^$key " "$cfg" || echo "$key \"\"" >> "$cfg"
done
echo "Installed Left 4 Dead 2 build ${build:-unknown}${SRCDS_BETAID:+ from the $SRCDS_BETAID branch}."

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server browser.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: The map the server starts on, such as c1m1_hotel.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: The password players join with, or empty for none.

variables.name: RCON password
variables.description: The password for remote admin tools, or empty to turn RCON off.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the game from Steam every time the server starts.

variables.name: Validate files
variables.description: Check every game file against Steam when installing or updating, which repairs damaged files but takes longer.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: The Steam beta branch to install, or empty for the normal release. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Beta password
variables.description: The password of a private beta branch, if it has one.

variables.name: Steam app ID
variables.description: The dedicated server's Steam app ID, which SteamCMD installs.
